description: This file is a combined script that manages changelog entries for a software project. It contains a shell function to normalize changelog entries, a Node.js script embedded within the shell script to process changelog files, and several validation functions to ensure proper changelog entry placement and reference integrity.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Normalizes changelog entries associated with a specific pull request number by moving entries from different sections to the 'Unreleased' section.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog updates for a specific PR are correctly placed and referenced, ensuring proper formatting and linkage in the changelog file.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Checks that the changelog does not have dangling or dropped PR references after a merge, maintaining referential integrity.
